title: Contract Pricing Agreement Contract Item List: Close-Out of Discontinued Items
content:
## Close-out of discontinued contract items — Contract Pricing Agreement

**The rule.** This policy records the close-out of a contract item the manufacturer discontinued. The close-out line is a removal line on the agreement's contract item list, effective on the discontinuation date, that records, as the contract unit price that ends, the close-out price this policy works out. For a discontinued item this policy closes out, and only for such an item, the removal takes effect on the discontinuation date without a notice period; every other removal by Corbett still takes effect only after the tier's contract item removal notice period, in calendar days, counted from the notice date, and a customer may still ask for removal of an item effective the next ship date. An item outside this policy's scope is not closed out under it.

**When the price is fixed.** The close-out price of a discontinued item is fixed only after the price claim most recently filed on that item carries a decision. While that claim shows no decision on the agreement's price claim records, the close-out price is not fixed.

**What the recording does.** One removal line is recorded for the item number named: it ends the item's contract price from the effective date given, records the close-out price as the contract unit price that ends, carries the item's product category, list price and supplier cost from its current price line, the day of recording as the notice date and a newly issued change reference. The customer sees the item drop off the contract item list from that date.

### Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `close_out_discontinued_item_dd8bcab8` and then calls it.

- `pricing_agreement_id` — reference number of the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement, read from the pricing agreement lookup (id).
- `sku` — the Corbett item number of the discontinued contract item exactly as the agreement's contract item records show it, copied character for character.
- `contract_unit_price` — the close-out price recorded as the contract unit price that ends, USD, 4 decimal places, rounded half up.
- `effective_date` — the ship date from which the item no longer carries its contract price, written YYYY-MM-DD.

### Return

On success: `status` ("closed out" when the removal line was written), `contract_item_id` (reference number of the new removal line), `sku` (the item number), `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `contract_unit_price` (USD, 4 decimal places, the price that ends) and `change_reference` (the change reference issued).
